description: Call this BEFORE you tell your human the work is done. Pass the kind of work. Each module's own review: 'ux', 'graphics', 'front-end', 'code-review', 'qa'. 'ui': render it and look at it, six review lenses (free: the user and accessibility lenses; Pro adds designer, writer, product manager and engineer), and the browser checks. 'code': run it, the verify rules and the tidy check. 'product': walk it through as the person it's for. 'writing': the copy review (Pro). 'other' (any other task): check it against what they asked, then the report rules. Every kind ends with how to report honestly.

kind.description: The kind of work you're about to call done. A page with new code: 'ui' (it covers the screen; also run the tidy check). A flow across screens: 'ux'. Images: 'graphics'. Front-end code: 'front-end'. Reviewing someone's change: 'code-review'. Testing before release: 'qa'.
